records.part: Visual Messaging Signs (VMS) and related software at 22 Caltrain stations
records.reason: The current VMS signs and their components are obsolete, and the related software is no longer supported by vendors.
records.installed_location: 22 selected Caltrain stations including SF, 22nd Street, Bayshore, San Bruno, Millbrae, Burlingame, San Mateo, Hayward Park, Hillsdale, Belmont, San Carlos, Menlo Park, Palo Alto, California Ave, San Antonio, Mountain View, Sunnyvale, Lawrence, Santa Clara, Diridon, Tamien
